items.t: Should Illumina Stock Holders Look At Thermo Fisher Instead?
items.sum: Illumina and Thermo Fisher Scientific both sell the tools labs use to study biology and find new drugs. They part ways on focus. Illumina is built around gene sequencing machines and their supplies. Thermo Fisher sells to many kinds of labs, with $47.4 billion of yearly revenue against Illumina's $4.5 billion.
